lines.text: If a white spot is not deeper than the skin and the hair is not white, the priest isolates the person three days.
If the sore has faded and not spread at the second checkup, the priest pronounces him clean, and he washes his clothes.
A diseased person wears torn clothes, covers his mouth, cries out 'Unclean,' and lives alone in a place outside Jericho.
If the mildew has spread by day seven, the item is harmful and unclean and must be burned.
